text: build a campsite at night in the first frost: three small children sitting right around the campfire, near the campfire, a small brown hedgehog, up over the campfire, three small brown sticks in a row, and right on the stick, six small white marshmallows

put a rooftop terrace together under a clear sky in the evening: a medium girl standing with a happy face facing left right next to the railing, a medium white table toward the middle, four small gold lanterns along the railing, and a small black cat right on the table
